text:
maria (prod): Quick sync request — we need a cross-team slot next week to arbitrate roadmap conflict: Search relevance tuning vs latency push. Need an agenda owner and time. Prefer Wed/Thu mornings PT. cc @alex (eng) @sam (infra) @ellen (design)

alex (eng): Wed morning works for me 9–10am PT. I can take agenda ownership if no one objects.

sam (infra): Thurs is better for infra (oncall Wed). If Alex can’t do Thu I'm fine to join.

ellen (design): Either day ok. Agenda suggestion: 1) recap impact metrics, 2) risk tradeoffs, 3) rollout & canary plan, 4) decision + follow-ups.

tania (data): Can we add an item to review evaluation sets? We should avoid diverging metrics.

maria (prod): Thanks — agenda sounds right. Need someone to own collating pre-reads. Alex — are you up for it?

alex (eng): Happy to own pre-reads + agenda. I’ll pull A/B results and perf regressions. Can someone volunteer to take notes/decision log?

ellen (design): I can take notes and own the decision log entry.

calendar-bot: Poll created — "Cross-team roadmap arbitration" — options: Wed 9am PT, Wed 9:30am PT, Thu 9am PT. Vote here: https://calendar.poll/abcd1234

maria (prod): Please vote by EOD today. Also please add any hard blockers in thread (e.g., travel, oncall) so we can pick a slot that doesn’t lose key people.

sam (infra): Voted Thu 9am PT. Oncall Wed morning.

alex (eng): Voted Wed 9am PT but I can shift to Thu if that gets more coverage.

tania (data): Voted Thu 9am PT. Travel Wed afternoon so prefer Thu.

maria (prod): Looks like Thu 9am PT is winning. I'll book the RFC review room and send invite once poll closes. Alex — can you post pre-reads by Tue EOD? Ellen will own notes + decision log.

alex (eng): Yep, will post link to doc + short TL;DR by Tue 5pm.

ellen (design): Note for agenda owner: please include expected acceptance criteria for whichever option wins so the PMs/eng know what to ship.

maria (prod): Agreed — include acceptance criteria and canary SLOs. Also adding a 10-min slot at the end for post-decision action assignments.

alex (eng): One more ask — can we surface cost delta estimates from infra ahead of time? Sam?

sam (infra): I’ll pull rough cost delta and expected infra risk points by Tue noon.

maria (prod): Perfect. Final checklist: Alex = pre-reads + A/B/perf; Sam = cost delta; Ellen = notes + decision log; Tania = eval set sanity check. Meeting owner = Maria to schedule; Agenda owner = Alex. If anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
